allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 5 m at 30 years and 10 m at 60. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: dark green fans, grey-brown boots.

generator.params.note: Sargent (1922, Sabal palmetto, p. 102): leaves 5 to 6 ft (1.5 to 1.8 m) long and 7 to 8 ft broad on petioles 6 to 7 ft (1.8 to 2.1 m), so a frond 3.6 m long, 0.54 of it petiole; the rachis runs nearly to the leaf's middle (costa 0.18 of the frond, segments 0.38, spread over 200 degrees so the blade is broader than long); the crown's leaves at first upright, then spreading nearly at right angles to the stem, and finally pendulous (old_angle 75, hang 35). FEIS (Sabal palmetto): a stem 30 to 60 cm through, uniform from base to crown, the leaves on a prominently arching midrib (fan_arch 35 degrees at the fan's edges). Set by eye: eighteen fronds a year living two and a half years, about 45 in the crown. Other values set by hand from general knowledge of the species, not fitted to measurements. The trunk's rise is set by eye, mostly as metres a year, with only a millimetre added for each frond, so a 30-year palm stands about 5 to 7 m to its crown's top.

generator.params.leaflet_scatter.note: What the palm program's values mean for a palm's stated characters: its frond is its whole leaf; fan or feather from its division pattern, with the petiole, its girth, rachis pieces and frond angles of the built-in fan or feather palms; suckers if it is clonal; the trunk's rise from its usual height less the crown, and its girth from its stated diameter or else its height.

generator.params.suckers.note: What the palm program's values mean for a palm's stated characters: its frond is its whole leaf; fan or feather from its division pattern, with the petiole, its girth, rachis pieces and frond angles of the built-in fan or feather palms; suckers if it is clonal; the trunk's rise from its usual height less the crown, and its girth from its stated diameter or else its height.

generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the palm base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the palm program gave as defaults until then.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (plant forms milestone F4). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
